title: Exact associated-sheaf chains transported to the projective line
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $S=k[x_0,x_1]$ with its total-degree grading, $P=\operatorname{Proj}S$ [def-nagata-affine-proj], and $C:P\cong\mathbf P^1_k$ a chart-compatible isomorphism [def-sc-p1-proj-chart-isomorphism], with $\mathbf P^1_k$ as in [def-sc-p1-standard]. Let $M,A_0,A_1,A_2$ be integer-graded $S$-modules (internal direct-sum gradings, with $S_nM_j\subseteq M_{n+j}$ and likewise for each $A_i$). Suppose the degree-preserving maps give an exact sequence $0\to A_2\xrightarrow{f_2} A_1\xrightarrow{f_1} A_0\xrightarrow{f_0}M\to0$. Let $F$ be an associated sheaf of $M$ [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf], specified by injective additive chart maps onto the degree-zero fractions on each positive homogeneous standard open, compatible with the degree-zero ring action and the localization restriction formula. Then there are associated sheaves $E_i$ of $A_i$, with these same three chart properties, and maps $g_2:(C^{-1})^*E_2\to(C^{-1})^*E_1$, $g_1:(C^{-1})^*E_1\to(C^{-1})^*E_0$, $g_0:(C^{-1})^*E_0\to(C^{-1})^*F$ on $\mathbf P^1_k$, with $g_2$ monic, $g_0$ epic and the chain exact at both middle terms. No freeness, finite-generation or coherence assumption is made.

proof.text: Apply graded_module_chart_data_exists separately to each A_i and choose E_i with their chart maps and all three compatibility properties.
Apply graded_chain_maps_exact to the fixed sheaves E_i and F, obtaining the monic/epic endpoints and exact chain on Proj.

Set P=pullback(C.iso.inv), Q=pullback(C.iso.hom). The natural isomorphisms pullbackComp, pullbackCongr applied to the inverse identities, and pullbackId exhibit P and Q as inverse equivalences. Map the three arrows using P; equivalence preserves their mono and epi properties. Extract the exact short complexes of the two adjacent pairs, map their exactness with ShortComplex.Exact.map, and combine them with ComposableArrows.exact_of_δ₀. The associated-sheaf chart data remain those chosen on Proj.
